prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: THREE separate tall portrait game backgrounds arranged as equal-width columns side by side, without gutters, frames or dividing rules. Each portrait is approximately 1:2.16, overall canvas approximately 3:2.16. Create full rectangular paintings, NOT icons. The supplied images are style/continuity references: luminous opaque gouache, selective fine ink, lapis, jade, burnt ochre, muted coral, warm ivory light. Monumental and intimate, a world being created, never a settlement. No text, numbers, words, ornamental borders, people unless explicitly specified, buildings, UI or watermark. Place dramatic landmarks mainly in the UPPER 42 percent of EACH portrait; the LOWER 58 percent must be a spacious calm medium-LIGHT desaturated blue-grey/ochre painted foreground with sparse broad atmospheric strokes, giving dark circular tokens readable working space. This calm area belongs naturally to each painting, not a rectangular UI panel or flat overlay. Preserve the three equal portrait panels. Recurring geography when visible: hooked ochre headland at upper left, a single arched cave at its foot when the requested era permits a cave, teal tidal inlet, pale dry rock shelf on the RIGHT inside the entrance and a broad dry upper interior wall above the tidal wash. The dry shelf is connected to exposed rock at the mouth, visibly above the water; do not flood the whole floor. Distant jagged coastal hills, pale Moon with a pair of adjacent unequal craters, consistent with reference. No actual Earth map. LEFT: Move closer to the SAME sea cave from a dry right-hand shelf at the mouth, looking obliquely into it. The hooked outer cliff remains visible above/left, turquoise tide far BELOW left, with a spacious DRY ochre upper wall and ledge occupying upper right. The natural wall is entirely BLANK. Daylight reflects into it. No paintings, objects, people or fire; this is the surface awaiting inhabitants' art. Lower working area calm pale sandy dry floor, visibly above water. CENTER: EXACT SAME camera, cave geometry, dry shelf and tide as the left panel. Now the dry upper wall bears simple handmade ochre/carbon pictures: one small antlered deer outline and a hand stencil, one clearly IMPOSSIBLE antlered mammal with FEATHERED WINGS, and a loose group of invented ivory stars. These are flat cave paintings, not live creatures. NO sauropod or extinct giant images, no writing, modern marks or musical notes. No people needed. Retain ample unpainted wall and calm dry lower floor. RIGHT: Look outward from this SAME cave's dry ledge across the recovered living coast toward a wide distant green horizon. Existing mature forest frames a central small bare sunlit clearing and wind moves a few leaves; no new grove fills the clearing yet. No living giant browsers, no buildings or human figures. The quiet final place for seeds to travel beyond the creator's view. Lower area pale sand and atmospheric shoreline.
